new_results.statement: If T=sum_{j>=3}s_j(M)^2<theta||M||F^2 and 0<eta<(1-theta)/2, then either dist_F(M,rank<=1)<sqrt(theta+eta)||M||F or E2(M)>=eta(1-theta-eta)||M||F^4. At theta=eta=1/16: rank-one distance <F/(2sqrt2) or E2>=7F^4/128.
In the E2 branch there are four disjoint original-coordinate banks and a matching with product of squared Frobenius block norms >=E2/16, hence >=7F^4/2048 at theta=eta=1/16.
For M=[[b,r^T],[c,D]], F=||M||F, row norm alpha and column norm beta, either |b|>alpha beta/(4F), or ||r||||c||>=(15/16)alpha beta and sqrt(sum incident 2x2 minors^2)>=(11/16)alpha beta.

The r22 bicore branch forces either an actual physical edge |M_ia|>(theta/1800)F and CR|M_ia|>theta*kappa/1800, or actual physical stars with product >(theta/480)F^2 plus incident second-minor mass sqrt(Z)>(11theta/7200)F^2.
